results.summary: Review FAILED after 3 cycle(s) with 2 blocking finding(s). Headless runs do not commit at the cycle cap; changes left unstaged.
findings: high/spec-deviation app/Actions/Publishing/RunEditorialActivity.php:312 — Plan activities are validated and marked completed, but applyResult only applies draft/research/review outputs; the generated outline/visualPlan is never staged onto the attempt or exposed as an approvable plan, so the required research → plan → human plan approval sequence stalls unless a human updates the plan out-of-band → Add Plan result application that stores the agent plan proposal/draft on the attempt for human review and cover the automated sequence with a workflow test

high/spec-deviation app/Services/Publishing/EditorialPrompts.php:164 — Review finding validation only checks that supporting_source_ids are known integers; it does not require supporting quotations to exist in stored extracted_text or flag absent/contradictory support as required by the Evidence section → Validate quote/support fields against EvidenceSource records before accepting findings, and add missing/contradictory quotation coverage
